caption: Missing parents and cycles keep the comment text and page.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pdf-reply-export']; for (const d of p.dialogs) d.close(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const d = await p.previewFiles([app.vault.getFileByPath('PDF Reply Export/probe/edge-cases.pdf')], false); if (!d) throw new Error('Preview missing'); d.list.scrollTop = d.list.scrollHeight; return 'ok'; })()

caption: A new review note with nested replies and source links.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pdf-reply-export']; for (const d of p.dialogs) d.close(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const d = await p.previewFiles([app.vault.getFileByPath('PDF Reply Export/probe/review-links-fixture.pdf')], false); if (!d) throw new Error('Preview missing'); const f = await p.writeReview(d.sources[0], 'Sample review'); window.__q31Note = f.path; d.close(); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: { file: f.path, mode: 'preview' } }); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getFileByPath(window.__q31Note); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro selects the comments by Bob.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pdf-reply-export']; for (const d of p.dialogs) d.close(); app.setting.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pdf-reply-export-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const d = await p.previewFiles([app.vault.getFileByPath('PDF Reply Export/probe/review-links-fixture.pdf')], false); if (!d) throw new Error('Preview missing'); const inputs = d.contentEl.querySelectorAll('.pdf-reply-export-filters input'); inputs[0].value = 'Bob'; inputs[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'ok'; })()
